messages:
sam: Noticed a spike in SCIM create events tied to the OIDC token change rollout. A handful of users ended up with duplicate service accounts. Anyone else seeing token claim diffs?
leila: Yes — token introspection shows `sub` claim sometimes coming as the user email and sometimes as a UUID. The IdP switched a setting for stable sub generation earlier today.
jin: SCIM-provisioner failed when reconciling duplicates because it couldn't decrypt the legacy envelopes. Error from node logs:
```
2026-04-14T16:10:12Z scim-provisioner WARN decrypt failed: KMSError(DecryptDenied) context_mismatch: expected context {"tenant":"redwood-prod","extid":"svcacct:abc"} got {"extid":"svcacct:abc"}
```
carol: So the legacy envelopes were created before we started including tenant in KMS context. After the IdP change, provisioning flows looked up extid by new-sub -> tried to use envelope but tenant context mismatch killed unwrap.
sam: That aligns with the audit: provisioning attempts timestamp 2026-04-14T16:09:xx, multiple DecryptDenied events in KMS logs. kms-bot: KMS: 7 DecryptDenied events for key arn:aws:kms:.../rekey-2026 in the 16:09-16:12 window.
leila: Immediate mitigation I propose: 1) temporarily allow legacy context shapes in kms-unwrap for specific envelopes created before 2026-04-01, 2) kick a rewrap job to re-encrypt envelopes with current context, 3) add IdP mapping to normalise `sub` to stable extid, 4) add integration test for token-claim-to-extid mapping.
jin: For (1) I can add a safe-guarded codepath: `kms.unwrap(envelope, accept_legacy_contexts=[{"extid_only":true}])` and log a structured audit entry for every legacy unwrap. Will gate it behind a feature flag and TTL 48h.
carol: For the rewrap job: we'll read envelopes, attempt unwrap via the legacy allowance, then kms.encrypt with current context, and atomically swap. I'll add corruption checks and a dry-run mode.
sam: Also need to ensure SCIM backfill won't accidentally deprovision existing accounts while we reconcile duplicates. Suggest `--no-deprovision` mode in the backfill and manual verification for the first 100 users.
leila: Agreed. I'll notify affected customers and coordinate an IdP config rollback option with the partner team.
kms-bot: action_req: create vuln-triage ticket if legacy unwraps > 0 and source != infra-admin. Current count: 3 legacy unwraps.
jin: I'll push the feature-flagged patch to prod canary now (5%) and monitor. Deploy-bot: deploy 17991 -> canary 5% started :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary metrics: error-rate on scim-provisioner from 6.4% -> 1.1% after patched mapping and kms allowance.
carol: Running rewrap dry-run on the first shard (shard-3) with `--dry-run --limit 200` now. No failures so far.
sam: Action items captured: jin -> temp kms-allow + audit logs; carol -> rewrap tool + dry-run; leila -> IdP mapping rollback plan + customer comms; sam -> coordinate SCIM backfill `--no-deprovision` and manual review. ETA for mitigation: 3h.
leila: We'll also add a postmortem to examine whether KMS context variance should be tolerable or if we need stricter binding at write time. Early note: we must avoid making unwrap tolerant long-term.
jin: Logging will include envelope_id, old_context_shape, operator, and unwrap_result. I'll push logs to sec-audit bucket for the 48h window for triage.
sam: Thanks team. If anything odd shows up in the rewrap or backfill we escalate to incident channel. :thumbsup:
